SYNTHETIC TEST TEXT. Mimics the article structure of a regulation. It is not
the text of any real regulation.

Article 1
Subject matter

This sample regulation lays down rules for sample AI systems.

Article 12
Record-keeping

Sample high-risk systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events over their lifetime, so that the functioning of the system can be traced.

Article 14
Human oversight

Sample high-risk systems shall be designed so that natural persons can oversee them effectively, including the ability to decide not to use the system or to override its output.

Annex III
High-risk use cases

Sample areas include access to essential public services and benefits.
